title: MYSTIC - CMB 46m
highlights: 2026 interior works included in the price
description:
MYSTIC is a 45.95-metre full-displacement motor yacht built by CMB Yachts in 2010, with exterior by Diana Yacht Design and interiors by Birgit Schnaase. Following a 2020 refit and an ongoing 2026 transformation, she offers six cabins for twelve guests, including two full-beam master suites.

RINA Charter Class and MCA LY2, she completed her 15-year survey in May 2025 and has a range above 4,500 nautical miles. The contracted 2026 works, a 2024 Axopar 29 chase boat and a full toy package are included in the asking price.
